items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: And Marva Louis, I arranged all her music

ctx.x: Yeah, and then go back there at 12:00 at night, play for the dancers. Here I had two jobs and never made a nickel. I'd have to go to one job and collect some money and go to the next job and pay off. I was gambling, that's when I was gambling.
I was up in Boston. And Marva Louis, I arranged all her music, and she --
She was the lady that married Joe Louis, right?
